description: Numerical verification at 50 dps that our framework's depth-n cyclotomic content decomposes into Dirichlet L-values. Concrete instance: beta(3) = L(chi_4, 3) = pi^3/32 derived constructively from Theorem A (prop:jonquiere-cyclotomic-tate-rationality) at (n, K) = (3, 4). Connects the graded-Mikusinski framework to classical analytic number theory (Dirichlet beta function and odd-character L-values). Also records the N = 5 case: Cl_3 values at zeta_5 generate the predicted (K-3)/2 = 1 dimensional genuinely-new content (plus zeta(3)-line), aligning with the L-value content of the 2 odd characters mod 5.

beta_3_from_theorem_a.interpretation: Catalan-like depth-3 L-value derived from Jonquière inversion (Theorem A) — classical beta(3) = pi^3/32 is a corollary of the framework.

N_5_l_value_content.interpretation: (K-3)/2 = 1 genuinely-new generator at N = 5, corresponding to the 2 odd characters mod 5 paired by complex conjugation. Theorem G dim count matches.
